steps.code:
# Approve all pending payment requests (those with approved_at == null and denied_at == null)
access_token = login_response['access_token']
pending_requests = [req for req in payment_requests if req['approved_at'] is None and req['denied_at'] is None]
print(f"Pending requests to approve: {[req['payment_request_id'] for req in pending_requests]}")

# Approve each pending request
for req in pending_requests:
    result = apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(access_token=access_token, payment_request_id=req['payment_request_id'])
    print(f"Approved request {req['payment_request_id']}: {result}")
